summary.scope: Complete independently audited80-state fine spatial history, three-level full-history nonconvergence and resolved-load model/numerical-error separation

fine_history_independent_audit.scope: Independently verify every precision-aware spatial state and its unaveraged global field.
fine_history_independent_audit.limitations: Every original dynamic step is independently reconstructed, including exact previous-state/velocity integration, unsmoothed centered normal/friction stencils, mass/armature and capped jaw PD. Raw global wide-coordinate field bounds remain visible. The original fixed-arm/two-jaw control and saved held initializer remain explicit. Full-arm application matching and physical spatial/contact/geometry convergence are separate incomplete requirements.

three_level_complete_history_fields.scope: Compare solved Panda spatial refinements at fixed material probes and physical times.
three_level_complete_history_fields.limitations: Fixed polyhedral geometry and physical held points. Configurations, explicit pairwise varying discretizations and fixed-contact-boundary markers define each comparison; body refinement changes contact triangles unless that boundary is frozen. A collision-only sweep keeps the volume fixed. Fixed material-coordinate interior probes carry seed-volume diagnostic weights, not an exact continuum norm. Tensors use each solution's proper finite body frame; contact wrenches use the shared fixed reference origin. Complete nonlinear global peak lower/upper bounds are retained separately. Two spatial levels or an equal-constructor control do not establish a physical tail. Contact quadrature/regularization/CAD geometry/full-arm support matching and feedback/model/accuracy-cost remain separate required studies.

resolved_linearization.scope: Separate resolved-load linearization from frozen-deformation constitutive differences on matched states.
resolved_linearization.limitations: One matched32.5ms state per mesh at unresolved physical spatial/contact settings. Replaying resolved full-inertia loads through independent linear FEM measures a combined finite-geometry/constitutive linearization discrepancy; the reference-wrench balance correction is explicit. Frozen-objective-deformation stress comparison diagnoses the constitutive assumption without claiming a new equilibrium solve. Rigid-relief comparison is not a corresponding solved rigid/deformable feedback case. Native numerical replay, physical convergence, full histories, remaining finite-footprint models and verified warmed cost remain separate requirements.

native_resolved_load_replays.scope: Check native numerical recovery separately from matched nonlinear-reference model differences.
native_resolved_load_replays.limitations: One matched32.5ms state per mesh at unresolved physical spatial/contact settings. This is actual production Quadrants recovery of independently resolved nodal loads. Same-discretization linear numerical error and finite-geometry/constitutive model discrepancy are reported separately. Full-inertia and rigid-relief loads define separate problems; neither establishes actual rigid/deformable feedback, finite-footprint load-model accuracy, physical convergence or warmed cost at verified accuracy.
